proof_scope: Heat-kernel Hessian multipliers, off-support size/gradient and dyadic cancellation give weak(1,1); explicit distribution-function integration and truncated adjoint testing prove every 1<p<infinity estimate without imported interpolation or Lp-duality theorems. Taylor gradient interpolation, ray-average Morrey and weak-coordinate definitions close the Sobolev prerequisites. Frozen coefficients and gradient absorption give a smooth compact elliptic estimate; a monotone regularized power test bounds the smooth resolvent, and source approximation plus the earlier distributional inverse identities give W2,p for arbitrary global Lp data. Continuous global bounded-metric-Laplacian functions are W2,p for every finite p including p=1 by finite volume, and C1,alpha for alpha<1. Holder makes every weak barrier determinant/mixed wedge a signed finite measure with all finite Lq densities; its regular contact restriction is positive. No endpoint strong singular-integral estimate, full real C1,1, envelope PDE or arbitrary irregular-psh contact is claimed. No new external input.
